name: row policy skip
source:
function parseRows lines
 put [] into rows
 repeat for each line in lines
  try
   put line as number after rows
  offer skip
   next repeat
  offer useValue value
   put value after rows
  end try
 end repeat
 return rows
end parseRows
on go
 try
  return parseRows(["5", "bad", "7"])
 catch {code: "can't convert"} before unwind
  choose offer skip
 end try
end go

name: catch tests see state before cleanup
source:
script variable mark = 0
function fail
 try
  throw "bad"
 finally
  put 1 into mark
 end try
end fail
on go
 try
  put fail() into ignored
 catch "bad" where mark = 0
  return mark
 end try
 return 99
end go

name: deeper cleanup precedes action and owner cleanup follows
source:
script variable order = ""
function fail
 try
  throw "bad"
 finally
  put "deep" after order
 end try
end fail
function work
 try
  put fail() into ignored
 offer recover
  put ":action" after order
 finally
  put ":owner" after order
 end try
end work
on go
 try
  put work() into ignored
 catch "bad" before unwind
  choose offer recover
 end try
 return order
end go

name: rejecting intermediate catches preserve offers

name: catch-all is an offer barrier
source:
function parseRows lines
 put [] into rows
 repeat for each line in lines
  try
   put line as number after rows
  offer skip
   next repeat
  offer useValue value
   put value after rows
  end try
 end repeat
 return rows
end parseRows
function wrapper lines
 try
  return parseRows(lines)
 catch e
  throw e
 end try
end wrapper
on go
 try
  return wrapper(["bad"])
 catch e before unwind
  put offerAvailable("skip") into available
 catch e
  return available
 end try
end go

name: availability in Guard and synchronous helper
source:
function parseRows lines
 put [] into rows
 repeat for each line in lines
  try
   put line as number after rows
  offer skip
   next repeat
  offer useValue value
   put value after rows
  end try
 end repeat
 return rows
end parseRows
function available
 return offerAvailable("skip")
end available
on go
 try
  return parseRows(["5", "bad", "7"])
 catch e before unwind where offerAvailable("skip")
  if available() then choose offer skip
 catch e
  return []
 end try
end go

name: nearest offer wrong arity does not fall back
source:
function work
 try
  try
   throw "bad"
  offer recover value
   return value
  end try
 offer recover
  return 99
 end try
end work
on go
 try
  return work()
 catch e before unwind
  try
   choose offer recover
  catch "wrong arity"
   put 8 into replacement
  end try
  choose offer recover(replacement)
 end try
end go

name: availability malformed unknown and wrong-kind queries
source:
on go
 try
  throw "bad"
 offer recover value
  return value
 catch e before unwind
  put [offerAvailable("recover"), offerAvailable("missing"), offerAvailable("bad name"), offerAvailable("")] into result
  try
   put offerAvailable(1) after result
  catch "wrong kind"
   put "wrong kind" after result
  end try
  choose offer recover(result)
 end try
end go

name: arguments evaluate left to right and bind atomically
source:
script variable count = 0
function increment
 add 1 to count
 return count
end increment
on go
 try
  throw "bad"
 offer pair first, second
  return first * 10 + second
 catch e before unwind
  choose offer pair(increment(), increment())
 end try
end go

name: ordinary acceptance cleanup error replaces original
source:
function fail
 try
  throw "bad"
 finally
  throw "cleanup"
 end try
end fail
on go
 try
  try
   put fail() into ignored
  catch "bad"
   return "accepted"
  end try
 catch e
  return the code of e & ":" & the code of the during of e
 end try
end go

name: recursion chooses nearest offer
source:
function down n
 try
  if n > 0 then return down(n - 1)
  throw "bad"
 offer recover
  return n
 end try
end down
on go
 try
  return down(3)
 catch "bad" before unwind
  choose offer recover
 end try
end go

name: throw retains counted-loop iterator during dispatch
source:
function worker
  put 0 into total
  repeat 2 times
    try
      throw "bad"
    offer recover
      add 1 to total
    end try
  end repeat
  return total
end worker
on go
  try
    return worker()
  catch e before unwind
    choose offer recover
  end try
end go
